description: Calculate single non-defaulted exposure IRB risk weight, correlation, effective PD/LGD floors, RWA and 8% capital. Supports corporate/SME and retail under EU CRR/CRR3 or BDDK current/draft. Requires explicit regime; PD 1 means 1%.

annualSales.description: Required for corporateSme: consolidated annual turnover in EUR millions for EU, TRY millions for BDDK.

currency.description: Optional three-letter currency label; no currency conversion is performed.

ead.description: Optional exposure at default in currency units. No customer identifiers.

lgd.description: Loss given default in percentage points: 40 means 40%.

maturity.description: Corporate maturity in years; omitted means 2.5. Not applicable to retail.

pd.description: Probability of default in percentage points: 1 means 1%, not 0.01. Defaulted exposures are unsupported.

qrreTransactor.description: CRR3 qrre only: true for a QRRE transactor (balance repaid in full at each scheduled date over the previous 12 months, or overdraft not drawn in that period), which uses the 0.05% PD floor instead of 0.10%. Never infer it.

regime.description: Required rule book. bddk is current Turkish rules; bddkDraft is a draft, not current law. Never infer jurisdiction from the conversation language.

smeLimit.description: Required Board limit C in TRY millions for bddkDraft corporateSme. Current BDDK uses 1000; EU uses 50 EUR million.

name: calculate_irb
title: IRB credit risk weight and capital
